key_insight: AMM uses online landscape probes to route a fixed evaluation budget among classical optimizers, achieving the highest target share in 382 of 600 held-out BBOB evaluation cells, including ties.
engineering_relevance: For continuous black-box optimization, AMM offers an open-source Python router that adapts optimizer choice to landscape structure and remaining budget.
method: Probe curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure online.
Route evaluations among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy engines.
Charge probe costs to the budget and apply dimension-by-budget validity ranges and defaults.
evidence_signal: A one-time held-out BBOB test covered instances 101–110, dimensions 2–40 and budgets of 10D–1000D against up to seven competitors; AMM led outright in 236 cells and tied for the lead in 146.
watch_item: Gains were benchmark-dependent: rotating separable functions f3–f4 removed most of the lead, while held-out MA-BBOB showed parity with IPOP-CMA-ES at the final budget and lower anytime performance.
paper_title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
